availability: The complete binary packages are delivered separately; this repository contains reports, scientific metadata and reproducibility code.
manifest: Each ZIP embeds PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json with payload sizes and SHA256; CRC and every archived member SHA256 were checked. Archive identity is recorded here externally to avoid self-reference.
source_subset_limit: The S2017 raw package authenticates selected HDF5 chunks and decoded rows; it does not verify the full telescope source file catalog MD5.
older_2016_raw: Four previous native-154/155/157/158 raw packages remain separate and are listed with exact identities in DATA_AVAILABILITY.md.
